title: 时间顺序

sentenceFrames.usage: 任何有转折的故事。"At first... but then..." 是最基本也最好用的故事结构。
sentenceFrames.example: At first, everything was going according to plan — we got to the airport on time, the flight was smooth. But then we landed and realized our luggage was in a different country.
substitutions: At first, **I didn't think much of the opportunity.** But then _____.
At first, **learning to speak felt impossible.** But then _____.
At first, **I was terrified of public speaking.** But then _____.
你的经历：At first, _____. But then _____.

sentenceFrames.usage: 表达某事发生得比预期快，或不知不觉中就发生了。
sentenceFrames.example: Before I knew it, three hours had passed and I was still on that phone call — we talked like old friends.
substitutions: Before I knew it, **the deadline was 2 days away and I hadn't started.
Before I knew it, **I had spent 500 yuan on things I didn't need.
Before I knew it, **6 months had passed and I could actually hold a conversation in English.
你的经历：Before I knew it, _____.

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：The next thing I knew, [surprising event — often dramatic].
sentenceFrames.usage: 强调事件的突然性和戏剧性。比 "and then" 有冲击力得多。
sentenceFrames.example: I closed my eyes for what felt like one second. The next thing I knew, the sun was up and my phone was buzzing with 15 missed calls.
substitutions: I was just walking down the street, minding my own business. The next thing I knew, _____.
I sat down to watch one episode before bed. The next thing I knew, _____.
I thought the conversation was going fine. The next thing I knew, _____.
你的故事：_____. The next thing I knew, _____.
